نتدارأ (form VI)
# نَتَدَارَأُ (natadāraʔu) /na.ta.daː.ra.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# نَتَدَارَأَ (natadāraʔa) /na.ta.daː.ra.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# نَتَدَارَأْ (natadāraʔ) /na.ta.daː.raʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
